source: All 1,233 historical reference entries and their attribution are preserved. Revision 13 adds 79 individually reviewed spellings: 38 ordinary nominative plural nouns, two singular nouns, 37 everyday adverbs and two adjectives. Wiktionary contributors retain CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution; exact source revision links document the selected sense or plural. For four Georgian explanatory-dictionary additions, brief English glosses are original editorial wording and the linked definitions are verification sources. Sources were inspected on 2026-10-17. No automatic morphology or native-speaker sign-off is claimed. Revision 17 preserves all 1312 prior entries and adds 130 individually source-checked, owner-approved noun/adjective senses from expansion batch 02. Exact Wiktionary source revisions and concise attributed glosses accompany each addition; sources checked on 2026-10-18. No native-speaker sign-off is claimed. Revision 18 preserves all 1442 previous reference entries and adds 131 owner-approved senses from expansion batch 03; nine rejected proposals are not ingested. Fixed source revisions, concise glosses and supplemental verification links are retained. Source checks were completed on 2026-10-18; no additional native-speaker review is claimed. Revision 19 preserves all 1573 prior reference entries and adds 129 owner-approved batch-four senses. Nineteen rejected proposals are not ingested. Wiktionary fixed revisions and Georgian explanatory-dictionary URLs/content hashes preserve provenance; concise English glosses only, not full explanatory definitions. Sources were checked on 2026-10-18. No additional native-speaker review is claimed.
